finding.summary: Tessera profiles post-overlap cost on a reference device group and reuses the plan across matching ranks.

paper.quote: Tessera executes the synthesized schedule on a reference device group, a dedicated device set configured with the same TP/EP topology as the target rank, to measure ground-truth post-overlap cost.
Results are cached by device-mesh class and chunk specification for reuse across ranks and replicas with matching GPU type and interconnect pattern.
peaks at about 3,050 seconds at 128K for the trillion-scale PP8-C2 case

analysis.tier_note: paper-only: the quotes were verified against the PDF text, nothing else could be checked
analysis.reasoning: Plan quality depends on the reference group matching the target’s GPU type, topology, and interconnect; profiling is offline and can take up to 3,050 s, and drift or heterogeneity would invalidate cached costs.
analysis.would_confirm: Compare plans profiled on the reference group against plans profiled on the actual target ranks under hardware/interconnect variation.
